Cost: x2 Base Weapon Cost [Minimum 1,000eb] ♦ Availability: +1 Price Category of Base Weapon [Minimum V. Expensive] ♦ Required Slots: 0

Fits: All Ranged Weapons that only fire Bullets, Slugs, and/or Shells

Electrothermals replace gunpowder with liquid propellant flash-fried via 100,000 amps, temporarily generating plasma that hyper-accelerates rounds. Extensive modification is necessary to handle the heat surge, and ETE ammo isn’t compatible with self-cycling actions, but it can boost damage and range by up to 50%. Overcome the laws of physics.

Attaching this attachment requires a DV24 Weaponstech Skill Check, and afterwards it cannot be uninstalled. While installed, the weapon is incapable of Autofire, Suppressive Fire, and any form of Burst Fire if not already so, and any BODY requirements it or its functions have (if any) are increased by 3 (e.g., BODY 10+ becomes BODY 13+).

If the weapon does not require an Action to cycle its bolt after it is fired before it can be fired again, it does now. This does not alter ROF, thus still allowing ROF 2 ETE weapons to have their Attacks be split between other ROF 2 Actions (Such as other ROF 2 ETE weapons). When now buying Ammunition for the weapon, its Cost is doubled and Price Category increased by one (e.g, Armor-Piercing is 200eb (Expensive)), and may only be used by the weapon it is bought for.

In return, the weapon now deals 2d6 additional damage in Single Shot or when firing Shotgun Shells. Also, when now firing the weapon at a target beyond 25m/yds, if the Attack Check is DV21 or higher, the user gains a +1 bonus to the Check, or +2 if it is DV24 or higher.

Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Costs twice the base weapon's cost (minimum 1,000eb); the listed price is the minimum.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Internal Components).
